subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation accept the broad browser SSRF private-network opt-in as authorization, or only models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork?
rationale: Both shapes are technically viable, but they define different operator authorization boundaries; repository history contains an older browser-policy precedent and a newer provider-scoped request contract.

options.title: Require provider-scoped opt-in
options.body: Authorize xAI image requests only through sanitized models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork so browser navigation policy does not grant provider egress.

options.title: Accept either explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep both authorization paths, matching the existing OpenAI image precedent while broadening the browser setting's effect to xAI provider traffic.

recommendation.title: Require provider-scoped opt-in
recommendation.body: Authorize xAI image requests only through sanitized models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork so browser navigation policy does not grant provider egress.
